item.name: Point increase with non-UUID user returns custom not found

exec: pm.test('Unknown user returns custom 404 without UUID format validation', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.response.to.have.status(404); pm.expect(body).to.include({ errorCode: 'POINT_USER_NOT_FOUND', errorName: 'PointUserNotFound', statusCode: 404 }); pm.expect(body.path).to.equal('/users/not-a-uuid/points/increase'); pm.expect(new Date(body.timestamp).toISOString()).to.equal(body.timestamp); });

item.name: Login returns admin user and points

exec: pm.test('Admin login returns public user fields and points', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(Object.keys(body).sort()).to.eql(['accountType','availablePoints','displayName','uuid']); pm.expect(body.uuid).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(body.accountType).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(body.availablePoints).to.be.a('number').and.at.least(0); pm.expect(body).not.to.have.property('password'); pm.expect(body).not.to.have.property('id'); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.has('Set-Cookie')).to.equal(false); pm.collectionVariables.set('loginUserUuid', body.uuid); });

pm.test('Repeated login succeeds with the same user', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(body.uuid).to.equal(pm.collectionVariables.get('loginUserUuid')); pm.expect(body.availablePoints).to.be.a('number').and.at.least(0); });

pm.test('Missing login fields return custom 400', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.response.to.have.status(400); pm.expect(body).to.include({ errorCode: 'AUTH_INVALID_LOGIN_INPUT', errorName: 'InvalidLoginInput', statusCode: 400, path: '/auth/login' }); pm.expect(new Date(body.timestamp).toISOString()).to.equal(body.timestamp); });

pm.test('Blank credentials return custom 400', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.response.to.have.status(400); pm.expect(body).to.include({ errorCode: 'AUTH_INVALID_LOGIN_INPUT', errorName: 'InvalidLoginInput', statusCode: 400, path: '/auth/login' }); pm.expect(new Date(body.timestamp).toISOString()).to.equal(body.timestamp); });
